priorAbsorption: WS2-T0 used these current extension surfaces as local read-only owner evidence. The governed launcher is accepted only as an owner for fixed-profile command admission; no technical zero-network isolation, implementation, provider, or runtime proof is claimed.

findings.summary: The governed launcher provides deny-by-default fixed-profile admission and receipt sequencing but no technical zero-network equivalence.

findings.summary: The inspected worker-thread and declared sandbox-platform surfaces do not prove socket, environment, filesystem, or transitive-child containment.
findings.nextAction: Keep technical zero-network isolation parked; do not promote sandbox labels or allowlist membership to enforcement proof.

findings.summary: A future continuation needs an exact command contract plus a source-backed environment, effect, and network enforcement/proof boundary.
findings.nextAction: Require a fresh operator checkpoint and governance packet before any design, test execution, or implementation tranche.
